03How it works

From discovery to go-live.

Five steps, with a live test link every Friday so you see progress instead of hearing about it.

01

Discovery

A 20-minute call to understand the work your team does by hand today and what a good result looks like.

02

Architecture

A written scope: what we build, which tools it connects, what it costs and the delivery date in working days.

03

Connect

We design and build every page, connect the enquiry form to WhatsApp and a sheet, and set up domain, hosting, SSL and analytics in your name.

04

Sandbox testing

Every Friday you get a live test link. We test with your real examples, not made-up ones.

05

Go live

Launch, founder review, handover of everything to your accounts, and included support starts.

05Questions

Questions about Websites.

Ask us directly
How many design changes do I get?

Two rounds of design changes are included with every website. Further rounds are quoted at a fixed price before we start them.

Can I edit the site myself?

Yes. Business and Commerce sites include an editable blog or news section, and we train your team. Launch sites can be edited through a Care plan.

Can the site be in Hindi as well as English?

Yes. Two languages are included in the Commerce or corporate package. For other packages, a second language is quoted at a fixed price.

What happens if the site goes down?

Hosting is in your name, so you always have access. With a Care plan we monitor uptime and respond within 48 hours, 24 hours or 4 working hours depending on the plan.

Do I own the website?

Yes. Domain and hosting are in your name from day one, and the full source files pass to you on final payment.
